goal: Build the shared app-content chrome (glass toolbar/sidebar) and a persisted mock filesystem, then implement Finder fully (sidebar, list/icon views, navigation, folder create/rename).
summary: Phase 3 complete: App framework + mock FS + Finder app fully built. Step 1: Created src/fs/mockFS.ts — tree-based in-memory FS with FSNode/FSEntry types, operations (list/read/write/mkdir/move/remove/exists/isDirectory/isFile/resetFS), path utilities (normalizePath with . and .. resolution, joinPath, parentPath, basename), default seed tree (Applications/Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Pictures/Music), localStorage persistence via custom Map↔JSON serialization, useMockFS React hook (useSyncExternalStore). Created src/system/AppFrame.tsx — shared app-content chrome with glass toolbar (top), glass sidebar (left), and content area slots. Added app-frame/toolbar/sidebar/content CSS. Created src/fs/mockFS.test.ts — 21 tests covering path utilities + all tree operations + edge cases. Step 2: Created src/apps/finder/manifest.tsx (AppManifest with JSX SVG icon, 720x480 default window). Created src/apps/finder/Finder.tsx — uses AppFrame with glass toolbar (back button, breadcrumb nav, new-folder, list/icon view toggles, delete) and glass sidebar; list view (Name/Kind/Size table), icon view (grid), double-click to open folders, breadcrumb navigation, new folder with inline rename (Enter/Esc/dedup), rename via move(), delete via remove(), useMockFS reactivity. Created src/apps/finder/Sidebar.tsx — Favorites section with active highlight + aria-current. Created src/apps/finder/finder.test.tsx (7 tests) + src/e2e/finder.spec.ts (9 tests including mock-FS persistence after reload). Full suite: `npx vitest run` → 36 passed; `npx playwright test` → 44 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (53 modules).
